mentions.name: German study helper app
mentions.description: This app helps with German language study by generating Anki flashcards from text, extracting highlighted words from papers to create Anki cards, and providing a collection of texts and dialogs on random topics.
mentions.problem: Preparing Anki flashcards from texts and extracting vocabulary from papers is tedious manual work that the app simplifies.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I study German and decided to write app to simplify some tasks:
1) generate anki cards from text
2) extract highlighted words from paper and generate anki cards
3) collection of texts/dialogs on random topics
